sentences.text: This case has been listed today on the urgent mentioning of the learned counsel for the petitioner because of the Shradh of the grandmother of the petitioner.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Lakhisarai (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 06 of 2024 registered for the offence under Sections 376, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. At the very outset, learned counsel for the petitioner, without going into the merits of the case,
submits that the Shradh of the grandmother of the petitioner is going to take place tomorrow i.e. on 24.12.2025 and therefore he may be granted provisional bail to attend the same.

4. In view of the aforesaid submission, let the petitioner, above named, be released on provisional bail for a Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52582 of 2025(4) dt.23-12-2025 period of one week from the date of his release on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned District and Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, SC/ST, Lakhisarai/concerned Court below in connection with Lakhisarai (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 06 of 2024, subject to the condition that one of bailors should be father of the petitioner.
